hero.description: Where global flavours meet comfort, and every sip and bite becomes a beautiful memory.

about.title: More Than Just a Café.
about.quote: “Cafeana is where global flavours meet comfort, quality and good vibes. We believe that great food, a welcoming ambience and meaningful moments make every visit special.”
about.description: From the sizzle of high-heat wok tossing and aromatic Thai coconut broths to classic European slow reductions and rich Indian tandoor aromatics, our kitchen is a tribute to world gastronomy. Accompanied by hand-crafted mocktails and velvety specialty coffee, every plate is prepared with absolute hygiene, care, and heartfelt warmth.

hallmarks.title: Global Harmony
hallmarks.desc: Authentic Thai, Chinese, Continental, and Indian flavours side-by-side.

hallmarks.title: Obsessive Hygiene
hallmarks.desc: Pristine kitchen standards, fresh sourcing, and uncompromised care.

hallmarks.title: Comfort & Vibe
hallmarks.desc: Warm lighting, relaxed seating, and a space made for unforgettable conversations.

menu.title: A World of Flavours, Under One Roof.
menu.description: From fragrant Asian woks and simmering copper handis to refined European gastronomy, handcrafted coffees, and vibrant mocktails — embark on an unforgettable culinary escape.

categories.name: Thai Cuisine
categories.subtitle: Aromatic & Vibrant
categories.description: A harmonious interplay of sweet, sour, salty, and fiery profiles, infused with fresh lemongrass, kaffir lime, and velvety coconut reductions.

categories.name: Chinese Cuisine
categories.subtitle: Wok Mastered & Delicate
categories.description: Mastery of high-heat wok techniques and artisanal steamed delicacies, elevated with house-infused chili oils, aged reductions, and delicate textures.

categories.name: Continental
categories.subtitle: Classic European Elegance
categories.description: Refined European gastronomy showcasing slow-braised cuts, velvety reductions, handcrafted pastas, and buttery brioche craftsmanship.

categories.name: Indian Cuisine
categories.subtitle: Heritage & Spiced Warmth
categories.description: Time-honoured regional recipes simmered in traditional copper handis, celebrating warm Kashmiri saffron, cardamom, and buttery velvet gravies.

categories.name: Artisan Coffee
categories.subtitle: Roasted to Perfection
categories.description: Single-origin beans freshly ground for precision espresso extractions, silky micro-foam latte art, and slow-dripped aromatic morning brews.

categories.name: Craft Mocktails
categories.subtitle: Zero-Proof Botanical Elixirs
categories.description: Vibrant shaken concoctions combining ruby pomegranate, blood orange, smoked cinnamon, and sparkling botanical essences over hand-cut crystal ice.

categories.name: Decadent Desserts
categories.subtitle: Sweet Confectionery Finales
categories.description: Indulgent finales crafted with dark single-origin chocolate, warm molten centers, caramelized crusts, and warm berry reductions.

signatureDishes.title: Crafted with Care. Served with Love.
signatureDishes.description: Every signature creation at Cafeana is an ode to culinary mastery. Prepared with patience, pristine ingredients, and an unwavering commitment to flavour perfection.

items.title: The Burgundy Reserve Braise
items.description: Slow-simmered prime tenderloin glazed in a 48-hour spiced red reduction, accompanied by roasted autumn root purée and charred rosemary aroma.
items.quote: “Every layer of flavour tells the story of patience, passion, and precision.”

items.title: Velvet Crema Single Origin
items.description: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe roasted to a medium profile, extracted under 9 bars of pressure with steamed oat milk and fine dustings of Ceylon cinnamon.
items.quote: “A morning awakening in a porcelain cup, kissed with golden crema.”

items.title: Crimson Ruby Elixir
items.description: Fresh pomegranate reduction steeped with wild hibiscus, blood orange bitters, and sparkling mineral spring water over hand-carved crystal ice.
items.quote: “A symphony of ruby brightness, crisp botanical perfume, and refreshment.”

items.title: Dark Molten Cacao Gateau
items.description: Warm 72% Madagascar dark chocolate cake that yields a cascading river of warm ganache, paired with whipped vanilla bean chantilly.
items.quote: “The ultimate indulgence, where warm chocolate meets pure serenity.”

ambience.title: Good Food. Great Company. Beautiful Moments.
ambience.description: Designed as a tranquil sanctuary where time slows down. Immerse yourself in warm amber lighting, plush seating, and an ambience that celebrates genuine human connection.

moments.title: Intimate Candlelit Booths
moments.description: Plush velvet burgundy seating tucked beneath amber pendant fixtures, designed for private conversations, deep connection, and relaxed indulgence.

moments.title: The Artisanal Brew Bar
moments.description: Witness master baristas grind, weigh, and pour each cup with meditative precision at our gleaming espresso and pour-over counter.

moments.title: Lively Gatherings & Shared Laughter
moments.description: Spacious communal tables surrounded by warm wood finishes and golden lighting, where friends gather to share global platters and unforgettable memories.

moments.title: Architectural Warmth & Design
moments.description: A thoughtful blend of brushed brass accents, rich espresso wood, and soft beige textures that welcome you into a tranquil culinary sanctuary.

gallery.title: Moments Captured at Cafeana.
gallery.description: Every plate served, every espresso pulled, and every evening shared becomes part of our living tapestry. Explore our curated photography.

contact.title: Your Table. Your Moments. Your Cafeana.
contact.description: Whether you are reserving an intimate evening table, planning a celebration with dear friends, or seeking a quiet corner with artisanal coffee, we look forward to welcoming you.

fourthColumn.text: “A Little Escape. A Lot of Flavour.” We craft every cup of coffee and every recipe with genuine devotion to culinary art and guest serenity.
